text.p: SuperGen Inc said Monday Larry Ellison has joined its board of directors.
The company said in a statement Ellison has finalized his initial $15.3 million investment in SuperGen. Ellison has an option to buy an additional $25 million of equity in the company.

"We have always believed that Larry Ellison's contribution as an active board member will be every bit as important as the value of his financial investment," said Chairman and Chief Executive Dr. Joseph Rubenfeld.

SuperGen said the equity investment will be used for the ongoing development and commercialization of SuperGen's existing product pipeline and for the possible acquisition of new products and product candidates.

SuperGen is an emerging pharmaceutical company dedicated to the development and commercialization of products intended to treat life-threatening diseases, particularly cancer and blood cell disorders, as well as other serious conditions such as obesity and diabetes.
